subject.title: iOS chat polish: haptic feedback and Markdown transcript export

question: Should OpenClaw accept both linked iOS chat polish changes as the implementation for this issue, or narrow/defer one of them?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing iOS behavior on a stable surface, current main lacks it, and the issue has a protected maintainer label plus two open candidate PRs.

options.title: Review and land both PRs
options.body: Treat the haptics PR and transcript export PR as the intended split implementation, then close this issue after both merge.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Accept only one half now or request design changes on the linked PRs before this issue can close.

options.title: Defer or reject the polish
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PRs together with a clear product-direction rationale if the iOS chat polish is not wanted now.

recommendation.title: Review and land both PRs
recommendation.body: Treat the haptics PR and transcript export PR as the intended split implementation, then close this issue after both merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the linked proposal and has the strongest recent current-main history in the affected iOS/shared chat files.
